module_summary: Symmetric two-domain clear/reset controller built from two half controllers exchanging isolate/clear sequence phases over 4-phase asynchronous req/ack CDC links.

anchors.name: a_isolate_o
anchors.why: Side A isolate request driven by half controller A during clear sequence

anchors.name: a_clear_o
anchors.why: Side A clear request driven by half controller A

anchors.name: a_isolate_ack_i
anchors.why: Side A acknowledge that isolation is complete

anchors.name: b_isolate_o
anchors.why: Side B isolate request driven by half controller B

anchors.name: b_clear_o
anchors.why: Side B clear request driven by half controller B

anchors.name: b_isolate_ack_i
anchors.why: Side B acknowledge that isolation is complete

anchors.name: async_a2b_next_phase
anchors.why: Clear sequence phase sent asynchronously from side A to side B

anchors.name: async_a2b_req
anchors.why: 4-phase CDC request qualifying the A-to-B phase transfer

anchors.name: async_b2a_ack
anchors.why: 4-phase CDC acknowledge from B for A-to-B phase transfer

anchors.name: async_b2a_next_phase
anchors.why: Clear sequence phase sent asynchronously from side B to side A

anchors.name: async_b2a_req
anchors.why: 4-phase CDC request qualifying the B-to-A phase transfer

anchors.name: async_a2b_ack
anchors.why: 4-phase CDC acknowledge from A for B-to-A phase transfer

groups.name: Half controller A
groups.description: Side A initiator/receiver FSM sequencing isolate and clear

groups.name: Half controller B
groups.description: Side B initiator/receiver FSM sequencing isolate and clear

groups.name: A-to-B phase CDC
groups.description: Asynchronous 4-phase link carrying side A phase to side B

groups.name: B-to-A phase CDC
groups.description: Asynchronous 4-phase link carrying side B phase to side A
